verdict.rationale: RevenueCat can be driven without its dashboard. It offers a REST API authenticated with secret `sk_` keys for server-side actions like receipt import, refunds and granting entitlements. An MCP server lets AI assistants manage apps, Products and Entitlements without the dashboard, and scheduled exports and webhooks support unattended pipelines. Missing for 10: no official CLI or CI-specific integration docs, no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
